an7.58:1.1: cattārīmāni bhikkhave tathāgatassa arakkheyyāni tīhi ca anupavajjo.
an7.58:1.4: natthi tathāgatassa kāyaduccaritaṃ yaṃ tathāgato rakkheyya
an7.58:2.2: natthi tathāgatassa vacīduccaritaṃ yaṃ tathāgato rakkheyya
an7.58:3.2: natthi tathāgatassa manoduccaritaṃ yaṃ tathāgato rakkheyya
an7.58:4.2: natthi tathāgatassa micchāājīvo yaṃ tathāgato rakkheyya
an7.58:6.3: tatra vata maṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ sahadhammena paṭicodessati
an7.58:6.6: etaṃpahaṃ bhikkhave nimittaṃ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi
an7.58:7.1: supaññattā kho pana me bhikkhave sāvakānaṃ nibbānagāminī paṭipadā
an7.58:7.2: yathā paṭipannā mama sāvakā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti
an7.58:7.3: tatra vata maṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ sahadhammena paṭicodessati
an7.58:7.4: itipi te na sapaññattā sāvakānaṃ nibbānagāminī paṭipadā yathā paṭipannā tava sāvakā āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti
an7.58:7.6: etaṃpahaṃ bhikkhave nimittaṃ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi
an7.58:8.1: anekasatā kho pana me bhikkhave sāvakaparisā āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti
an7.58:8.2: tatra vata maṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ sahadhammena paṭicodessati
an7.58:8.3: itipi te na anekasatā sāvakaparisā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti
an7.58:8.5: etaṃpahaṃ bhikkhave nimittaṃ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi
an7.58:10.1: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri tathāgatassa arakkheyyāni imehi ca tīhi anupavajjoti.
